entries.EN: This setting controls how tightly the grass bushes are drawn in the game. The further the slider is, the closer the grass elements will be drawn to each other and the thicker it will be. ATTENTION! Excessive density of grass leads to strong brakes, if you want to adjust this parameter, do it a little, each time checking what happened.

entries.JA_new: この設定は、ゲーム内で草むらをどれだけ密に描くかを調整します。スライダーを上げるほど草の間隔が狭まり、密集して見えます。注意：草を密にしすぎると動作が大幅に重くなります。変更するときは少しずつ動かし、その都度表示を確認してください。

entries.EN: This setting adjusts the maximum distance at which the grass is drawn. The farther the slider is, the farther the grass edge will be. The slider allows you to adjust the distance in the range from 48 (standard range) to 240 meters. ATTENTION! The algorithm for drawing grass by the game is such that when the radius of the grass increases, the load on the video card increases in geometric progression. More or less acceptable values lie within 150-200 meters (the middle of the slider).

entries.EN:
This setting switches the anti-aliasing type. Available options are NVIDIA DLSS (Deep learning super sampling), AMD FSR2 (FidelityFX Super Resolution 2), TAA (Temporal anti-aliasing), SMAA (Subpixel Morphological AntiAliasing). 
 
NVIDIA DLSS (Deep Learning Super Sampling) is a revolutionary AI-powered rendering technology that improves graphics quality by using specialized tensor cores in GeForce RTX graphics cards. The technology became available in desktop and mobile graphics cards with the arrival of the RTX20 series. Anti-aliasing using DLSS produces results superior in quality to MSAA 8x, without causing performance drops. 
 
FSR is a less demanding and lower quality analogue from AMD. FSR 2.0 is supported by all AMD video cards from the RX 400 series and newer, as well as NVIDIA video cards from the 1000 series.

entries.JA_new:
アンチエイリアスの方式を切り替えます。NVIDIA DLSS（Deep Learning Super Sampling）、AMD FSR2（FidelityFX Super Resolution 2）、TAA（Temporal Anti-Aliasing）、SMAA（Subpixel Morphological Anti-Aliasing）を選べます。 
 
NVIDIA DLSSは、GeForce RTXのテンソルコアを使って画質を高めるAI描画技術です。RTX 20シリーズからデスクトップ版・モバイル版のビデオカードで利用できます。DLSSによるアンチエイリアスは、性能を落とさずに8倍MSAAを上回る画質を実現します。 
 
FSRはAMD製の、負荷が軽い一方で画質が低めの代替技術です。FSR 2.0はAMD Radeon RX 400シリーズ以降と、NVIDIA GeForce 1000シリーズ以降のビデオカードに対応しています。

entries.EN: This setting adjusts the degree of reflection of light on shiny and matte surfaces such as metal, leather, wood, etc. This is an"amateur" setting, and if you don't know exactly what you're doing, leave it at the default value. The further the slider is, the stronger the reflection effect, but do not overdo it - at large values, the surfaces begin to look like they are covered in plastic.

entries.EN: This setting adjusts the distance to which dynamic shadows are drawn in full quality. Above this distance, they begin to blur and the quality of their rendering decreases, as the shadow calculation switches to simplified mode. The slider adjusts the value in the range from 1 to 60 meters. Configure the parameter together with the shadow resolution (in the configurator). The more you set the slider, the more you should set the resolution of the shadow map for good quality.

entries.EN: This setting adjusts the intensity of ambient light independent of the sun. The higher it is, the lighter all the shaded areas in the game will be, and the paler the shadows from the sun will look. ATTENTION! This is an"amateur" setting, and if you don't know exactly what you're doing, leave it at the default value. Boost if the overall game seems too dark to you and you can't achieve the desired effect with the brightness/contrast sliders. It is not recommended to lift up too much - the image will lose its volume, it will look flatter.

entries.EN: This setting enables pre-calculated global lighting in the game. At the same time, ready-made hemi-lightmaps are used, which allow you to bring the image closer to photorealism. When this setting is enabled, the interior of the premises will become noticeably darker. The setting does not affect the performance, since the effect is calculated in advance, but keep in mind that the effects of pre - calculated global lighting and dynamic-r2_ssao, overlap. Accordingly, if you want to use both effects, it makes sense to lower the strength of the effect of both, so as not to get an unnecessarily dark image. Or, if speed is important to you, use only pre-calculated lighting, and disable dynamic global lighting.

entries.EN: This setting adjusts the effect of improved surface relief using the Steep parallax mapping algorithm. This algorithm uses ray tracing in the space of the elevation map to calculate the relief, which gives a more realistic and high-quality effect.
entries.JA_current: This setting adjusts the effect of improved surface relief using the Steep parallax mapping algorithm. This algorithm uses ray tracing in the space of the elevation map to calculate the relief, which gives a more realistic and high-quality effect.
entries.JA_new: Steep Parallax Mappingアルゴリズムで表面の起伏を強調します。高さマップ上の空間で光線を追跡して起伏を計算し、より現実的で高品質な効果を得ます。

entries.EN: This setting includes a component of the depth - of-field effect - real-time eye focus. Some people find it annoying, so we left the option to turn it off.
entries.JA_current: This setting includes a component of the depth - of-field effect - real-time eye focus. Some people find it annoying, so we left the option to turn it off.
entries.JA_new: 被写界深度の一部である、リアルタイムの目の焦点合わせを有効にします。煩わしく感じる人向けに、無効にする選択肢も用意しています。

entries.EN: This setting includes a component of the depth - of-field effect - focusing the eyes on the weapon when reloading.
entries.JA_current: This setting includes a component of the depth - of-field effect - focusing the eyes on the weapon when reloading.
entries.JA_new: リロード中に武器へ目の焦点を合わせる、被写界深度の効果を有効にします。

entries.EN: This setting includes a component of the depth of view effect - blurring the edges of the screen when aiming.
entries.JA_current: This setting includes a component of the depth of view effect - blurring the edges of the screen when aiming.
entries.JA_new: 照準中に画面の端をぼかす、被写界深度の効果を有効にします。

entries.EN: This setting adjusts the quality of the depth-of-field effect.
entries.JA_current: This setting adjusts the quality of the depth-of-field effect.
entries.JA_new: 被写界深度の品質を調整します。

entries.EN: This setting includes Detailed Terrain-displaying small details and roughness on objects.
entries.JA_current: This setting includes Detailed Terrain-displaying small details and roughness on objects.
entries.JA_new: ディテール表示を有効にし、オブジェクトの細かな凹凸を描画します。

entries.EN: Turning on flares from light bulbs.
entries.JA_current: Turning on flares from light bulbs.
entries.JA_new: ランプの光にレンズフレアを加えます。

entries.EN: The setup includes a simulated 'dirt' on the lens of the camera lens.
entries.JA_current: The setup includes a simulated 'dirt' on the lens of the camera lens.
entries.JA_new: カメラのレンズに付いた「汚れ」を再現します。

entries.EN: This setting includes the appearance of drops on the glass of helmets and gas masks during rain.
entries.JA_current: This setting includes the appearance of drops on the glass of helmets and gas masks during rain.
entries.JA_new: 雨天時にヘルメットやガスマスクのガラスへ雨粒を表示します。

entries.EN: The setting includes dynamic puddles that appear during rain.
entries.JA_current: The setting includes dynamic puddles that appear during rain.
entries.JA_new: 雨天時に動的な水たまりを表示します。

entries.EN: The setting enables surfaces to get wet when it rains.
entries.JA_current: The setting enables surfaces to get wet when it rains.
entries.JA_new: 雨が降ると地面などの表面が濡れるようにします。

entries.EN: The setting includes surround light for some lamps.
entries.JA_current: The setting includes surround light for some lamps.
entries.JA_new: 一部のランプにボリュームライトを加えます。

entries.EN: This setting enables reflections on the water and in puddles during rain.
entries.JA_current: This setting enables reflections on the water and in puddles during rain.
entries.JA_new: 雨天時に水面や水たまりへ反射を表示します。

entries.EN: Tessellation increases the quality of low-polygonal models of NPS, monsters, hands of the actor, animated objects (bottles, etc.). The angular models become more smoothed.
entries.JA_current: Tessellation increases the quality of low-polygonal models of NPS, monsters, hands of the actor, animated objects (bottles, etc.). The angular models become more smoothed.
entries.JA_new: テッセレーションを使い、NPC、ミュータント、プレイヤーの手、瓶などのアニメーションするオブジェクトの低ポリゴンモデルを高品質にします。角張ったモデルが滑らかになります。

entries.EN: This setting enables shader optimization mode. Allows you to raise the FPS on video cards with a narrow bus or low memory bandwidth.
entries.JA_current: This setting enables shader optimization mode. Allows you to raise the FPS on video cards with a narrow bus or low memory bandwidth.
entries.JA_new: シェーダーの最適化を有効にします。メモリバス幅やメモリ帯域が限られたビデオカードで、FPSを向上させられる場合があります。

entries.EN: Setting allows you to adjust the sharpness of the image. ATTENTION! This is a setting from the category \"for an amateur\", and SHOULD NORMALLY BE DISABLED. Include ONLY if you are a fan of granular images. At high values, it gives a noticeable halo around objects.
entries.JA_current: Setting allows you to adjust the sharpness of the image. ATTENTION! This is a setting from the category \"for an amateur\", and SHOULD NORMALLY BE DISABLED. Include ONLY if you are a fan of granular images. At high values, it gives a noticeable halo around objects.
entries.JA_new: 画像のシャープさを調整します。注意：好みが分かれる設定で、通常は無効にしてください。ざらついた映像が好みの場合のみ有効にします。値を上げると、オブジェクトの周囲に目立つハローが生じます。

entries.EN: The setup includes a surround of the fog. It is used to simulate muddy water, haze in lowlands, and similar effects.
entries.JA_current: The setup includes a surround of the fog. It is used to simulate muddy water, haze in lowlands, and similar effects.
entries.JA_new: ボリュームフォグを有効にします。濁った水や低地のもやなどを再現します。

entries.EN: INCOMPATIBLE WITH BREAKING LIGHT BULBS!
entries.JA_current: INCOMPATIBLE WITH BREAKING LIGHT BULBS!
entries.JA_new: 電球破壊エフェクトとは併用できません。

entries.EN: Adjusts the range of the sun. With this setting, you can win some FPS in sunny weather. You can reduce it, for example, by half. The picture will not change much, and the FPS will be higher.
entries.JA_current: Adjusts the range of the sun. With this setting, you can win some FPS in sunny weather. You can reduce it, for example, by half. The picture will not change much, and the FPS will be higher.
entries.JA_new: 太陽光の描画距離を調整します。晴天時にこの値を下げると、FPSを少し向上させられます。たとえば半分にしても、見た目はあまり変わらず、FPSが上がる場合があります。

entries.EN: The higher the resolution of the shadow maps , the clearer the shadows will be in the distance (more than ~15-20 meters from the GG-beyond the border of the near cascade of shadows). To avoid a noticeable deterioration in the quality of shadows at this border, it is recommended to set the resolution at least 4096x4096. The setting has a big impact on performance.
entries.JA_current: The higher the resolution of the shadow maps , the clearer the shadows will be in the distance (more than ~15-20 meters from the GG-beyond the border of the near cascade of shadows). To avoid a noticeable deterioration in the quality of shadows at this border, it is recommended to set the resolution at least 4096x4096. The setting has a big impact on performance.
entries.JA_new: シャドウマップの解像度を上げるほど、遠くの影（主人公から約15～20メートル先、近距離シャドウカスケードの境界より先）が鮮明になります。この境界で影の品質が目立って落ちないよう、4096×4096以上をおすすめします。動作への影響が大きい設定です。

entries.EN: Activates simultaneous loading of textures by multiple threads. It can slightly reduce the load time of the save if you have an SSD.
entries.JA_current: Activates simultaneous loading of textures by multiple threads. It can slightly reduce the load time of the save if you have an SSD.
entries.JA_new: 複数のスレッドでテクスチャを同時に読み込みます。SSDを使っている場合、セーブデータの読み込み時間を少し短縮できることがあります。

entries.EN: It makes sense to increase the viewing angle for wide monitors and depending on individual preferences.
entries.JA_current: It makes sense to increase the viewing angle for wide monitors and depending on individual preferences.
entries.JA_new: ワイドモニターを使う場合や好みに応じて、視野角を広げられます。

entries.EN: The player's viewing angle. If a value such as 0.45 or less (less in the middle of the slider), the weapon will be closer, if this is set to 0.65 or more (more the middle of the slider), the weapons in the game will appear on. It makes sense to individually configure for wide monitors and depending on the FOV.
entries.JA_current: The player's viewing angle. If a value such as 0.45 or less (less in the middle of the slider), the weapon will be closer, if this is set to 0.65 or more (more the middle of the slider), the weapons in the game will appear on. It makes sense to individually configure for wide monitors and depending on the FOV.
entries.JA_new: プレイヤーの視野角です。値を0.45以下（スライダー中央より左）にすると、武器が近くに見えます。0.65以上（スライダー中央より右）にすると、武器が画面上で大きく見えます。ワイドモニターを使う場合や好みに応じて調整してください。

entries.EN: This setting adjusts the intensity of hemi lighting. The higher it is, the lighter it will be. ATTENTION! This is an"amateur" setting, and if you don't know exactly what you're doing, leave it at the default value. Boost if the overall game seems too dark to you and you can't achieve the desired effect with the brightness/contrast sliders.
entries.JA_current: This setting adjusts the intensity of hemi lighting. The higher it is, the lighter it will be. ATTENTION! entries.JA_new: 半球光の強さを調整します。値を上げるほど明るくなります。注意：細かな調整向けの設定です。何を変えるか分からない場合は初期値のままにしてください。画面全体が暗く、明るさやコントラストのスライダーでも改善できない場合に調整してください。

entries.EN: This setting controls which frame in turn will be rendered in the 3D scope. By default - every 2. If you increase it, the FPS in the game will increase, but the FPS in the 3D scope will decrease.
entries.JA_current: This setting controls which frame in turn will be rendered in the 3D scope. By default - every 2. If you increase it, the FPS in the game will increase, but the FPS in the 3D scope will decrease.
entries.JA_new: 3Dスコープに何フレームごとに映像を描画するかを設定します。初期値は2です。値を上げるとゲーム全体のFPSは上がりますが、3Dスコープ内のFPSは下がります。

entries.EN:
This setting controls the rendering range of dynamic objects, with the exception of helicopters, crows and cars. The greater the range, the more objects will be processed by the renderer, and accordingly the FPS may be lower.
		%c[red] \nIn most cases, the default value of 250 meters should be optimal. It is recommended to increase it only if for some reason a greater rendering range of objects is needed.
entries.JA_current:

entries.JA_new:
動的オブジェクト（ヘリコプター、カラス、車を除く）の描画距離を調整します。距離を伸ばすほど描画対象が増え、FPSが下がる場合があります。
		%c[red] \n通常は初期値の250メートルが適切です。特別な理由でより遠くまで描画する必要がある場合にのみ、値を上げてください。

entries.EN:
If DLSS or FSR is enabled, this setting adjusts the scaling of the image in the 3D scopes to improve its clarity. %c[yellow] 
When set to 1, the image is not scaled. %c[green] 
Optimal value: 2. %c[red] 
Values greater than 2 may noticeably reduce FPS.

entries.JA_new:
DLSSまたはFSRを有効にしている場合、3Dスコープ内の映像の拡大率を調整し、鮮明さを高めます。%c[yellow]

推奨値は2です。%c[red]
